claim.capability: redaction-grader-v3 scores every case in its frozen suite deterministically, and the per-case rows it publishes recompute its headline numbers offline.
claim.scope: the 5-case frozen redaction suite (pii and secret kinds), graded offline with no model in the loop, at the pinned commit.
limitations: 5 cases is a smoke suite, not a benchmark; it says nothing about recall on inputs outside it.
rows-aggregate-v1 recomputes arithmetic over the rows we publish. It cannot tell a reader those rows are honest; only the replay block can.
one case (pii-ssn) fails and is reported as failing. The suite is not clean.

protocol.task: offline redaction grading over a frozen 5-case suite
protocol.grading: each case is graded by a fixed regex predicate over the output; no model, no sampling, no clock.
protocol.control_policy: every case is graded twice, once against the redacted output and once against a clean twin that must score 0.

commands: git clone https://github.com/someone-else/mytool issuer && git -C issuer checkout 1d77e51
( cd issuer && python -m mytool.grade --suite redaction-grader-v3 --out results.json )
replay.expected: every command exits 0 and cmp stays silent: the grader re-runs the frozen suite at the pinned commit and re-emits results.json byte-identically.
